_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/damage/test_prevent_damage_remove_counter.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. t_pr_horde is Unbreathing Horde's damage line -- a prevent_damage total shield on itself that removes one +1/+1 counter from it -- on a 0/0 Zombie; t_pr_sturdy is the same line on a 1/1, standing in for a Horde whose toughness another effect keeps above 0 so it can be hit with no counters on it. The Habit, ogre, blanket shield and Everlasting Torment come from prevent_damage_into_counters, prevent_all_damage and everlasting_torment.cards.json.
